scripts.lint: eslint src tests/desktop scripts/build.mjs scripts/package-macos.mjs scripts/execution-audit.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check

scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests/desktop scripts/build.mjs scripts/package-macos.mjs scripts/execution-audit.mjs package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:native: npm run build && CSTHINK_NATIVE_TESTS=1 playwright test --project=native
